valid.description: true if the input is a real English word or fixed phrase

meaning_zh.description: concise Simplified-Chinese gloss with POS labels, e.g. 'v. 放弃；抛弃  n. 放纵', at most 80 characters

meaning_en.description: short learner-friendly English definition, at most 160 characters

examples.description: 3 to 4 authentic sentences (empty only when valid is false)

mnemonic_zh.description: one-sentence memory tip in Chinese (词根词缀 / 联想 / 辨析), at most 60 characters, empty if nothing useful

image_keywords.description: concrete, photographable English search phrases (2-4 words each) for a stock-photo search

image_alt_zh.description: one Chinese sentence (at most 30 characters) describing the ideal picture and its link to the meaning

difficulty.description: 1 junior high, 2 senior high, 3 CET-4, 4 CET-6, 5 beyond CET-6
